query:
SELECT streamer_login AS "streamer_login!",
               COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count!",
               SUM(CASE WHEN total_sessions = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS one_timers
        FROM twitch_chatter_rollup
        WHERE last_seen_at >= $1
        GROUP BY streamer_login
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
